existing_rules: preserve; create CLAUDE.md imports only when absent; project status warns while neither CLAUDE.md nor .claude/CLAUDE.md imports .agf/managed/project-rules.md
version_requirement: Direct AGENTS.md support requires Claude Code v2.1.277+ and appropriate settings; CLAUDE.md import remains a compatibility option
managed_copy: Generated skill copies originate from the same framework source; do not edit copies independently

permissions.installation: not installed by project install; review the rules, replace the placeholder path and merge them into the project's settings
permissions.scope: loaded only when Claude Code starts in that project directory; a session started in a parent directory does not use a subdirectory's .claude/settings.json
permissions.covers: Read, Edit and Write by path pattern (a Read rule also limits Grep and Glob); Bash by command prefix, plus cp and shell redirection into a denied path
permissions.does_not_cover: programs that write files themselves, such as python3 -c; an allow rule can stop matching while a hook rewrites the command
permissions.execution_status: observed in headless Claude Code 2.1.325 sessions on 2026-11-16: Write, cp and redirection into a denied path were refused and a python3 -c write was not; a git push deny rule refused git push; a subdirectory's rules were unused when the session started in its parent; with a user-level command-rewriting hook loaded, a Bash(git push:*) allow rule did not apply while the deny rule still did; a Read rule limited Read and Glob; --restricted confined Read and Glob to the working directory
